levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: the saying is the Imam's answer inside the scene (his words are quoted: «فَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ إِنَّمَا تَعَجَّبْتُ»), so he is the last link after Muhammad b. Dawud (rule 6, owner ruling 2); written as the report names him (owner ruling 3)
«الرضا» is the place where the scene happens and «أخيه» is a bystander: neither is a link
